preparation: Use approved FullPackage RTPLAN for the selected machine/energy; verify 10x10 output/reference first; use fixed phantom/Octavius/EPID geometry and approved TPS dose.
procedure_steps: 1) 10x10. 2) 02x02/3ABUT. 3) DMLC1. 4) 7SegA + FOURL. 5) 1234S/W/V. 6) CVMAT. 7) If failure occurs, stop expanding the battery and follow FullPackage диагностика. 8) Reserve/conditional fields only for localization or modality-specific validation. 9) No automatic registration in the primary geometry-sensitive comparison.
records_to_keep: For each energy: plan/dose version; detector/calibration/setup; raw measured/calculated data; point dose/OF; profiles; predefined ROI vectors/junction metrics; gamma criteria/map if used; any diagnostic shift; result and action in Журнал FullPackage.
decision_rule: Reference output must be valid. 02x02 uses MLC-A1. DMLC1/CVMAT low-gradient point dose target ≤2% TPS. For 3ABUT/7SegA/FOURL/1234 use validated baseline/sensitivity and field-specific metrics; gamma is secondary, not the sole PASS/FAIL.
short_method: Sequence: 10x10 reference → 02x02/3ABUT → DMLC1 → 7SegA/FOURL → 1234S → 1234W → 1234V → CVMAT. Use YOnly/HIMRT/HDMLC and reserve fields conditionally. Primary comparison must preserve planned geometry; auto-registration only as documented diagnostic.
measurand: Reference dose; corrected OF; junction metrics/profiles; DMLC point dose and ratio; gap-specific ROI vectors and W/S/V ratios; CVMAT point dose; diagnostic gamma/difference maps
action_limit_text: No single universal FullPackage gamma action limit. DMLC1/CVMAT low-gradient point dose: target ≤2% TPS; 02x02 follows MLC-A1; junction/gap/transmission spatial metrics use validated commissioning baseline/sensitivity and field-specific local limits.
nonconformance_text: Do not adjust accelerator solely to reduce TPS discrepancy. First verify 10x10/output/setup, then follow FullPackage diagnostic tree and separate machine, TPS model and measurement-system causes.
